description: T-4618: the T-4618 probes fit a load order that takes the active sheet first: an earlier-loaded =S!N makes S's bare =N, loaded before N = =1 is added through the API scoped to S, read the new name, unless a bare =N loaded before it (probes/t4618-earlier-qualified-only reads 1 with T active, t4618-earlier-qualified-only-active #NAME? with S active). Tabs P, Q, R with Q active (holding no use) and N scoped to P: R holds =P!N, P the bare uses. After the active Q, does the load go on to R before P (P's uses read 1)?
